thread:
lara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem—I've rolled the remediation items into one watchlist. Need owners for: (1) reconnect/backoff logic, (2) partial/truncated detection + safe retry, (3) timeout e2e + SDK guidance, (4) dashboards/alerts. Please claim and give an ETA.

 tom: I'll take reconnect/backoff. Plan: per-session resume lock, cap attempts=3, exp backoff + jitter, per-customer circuit-breaker when resume_fail_rate high. ETA 2026-02-06. Opening WIP PR GH#1419.

 keisha: I'll own partial/truncated detection. Will emit `stream.partial` with req_id + kv_checksum, tag by model/pool, validate signal via telemetry-only push then implement safe retry when idempotent. ETA 2026-02-10. Ticket REM-2026-203.

 lara: Obs owner? Need dashboards for incomplete_streams, resume_fail_rate, and proxy_503_tail. Also weekly watch alert.

 telemetry-bot: Will scaffold Grafana folder `streams/reliability-watch` and add panels. Proposed alerts: incomplete_streams > 0.03% (5m), resume_fail_rate > 0.25% (5m). ETA 2026-02-02.

 tom: sample trace we keep seeing:
```
2026-02-12T02:11:04Z req=0x2f3a stream=112 status=partial tokens=172 err=EOF
2026-02-12T02:11:04Z req=0x2f3a reconnect=1 route=gpu-pool-2 latency_ms=4720
2026-02-12T02:11:06Z req=0x2f3a final=client_deadline
```
Repro on load spikes ~3x per window.

 keisha: I'll tag metrics by model+pool and push telemetry-only change first. If signal looks clean, follow-up will add automated retry logic guarded by idempotency.

 devops-bot: CI job `ci/stream-timeout-sim` scheduled to run hourly on canary and dedicated. Job ID ci-17967-4.

 lara: Action summary (short IDs):
- J1: Reconnect/backoff  owner: tom  due: 2026-02-06  PR: GH#1419
- J2: Partial/truncated detection  owner: keisha  due: 2026-02-10  Ticket: REM-2026-203
- J3: Timeout e2e + SDK guidance  owner: lara  due: 2026-02-07  CI: ci/stream-timeout-sim
- J4: Dashboards + watch alert  owner: telemetry-bot  due: 2026-02-02  Dash: streams/reliability-watch

 tom: STATUS 2026-02-03: PR GH#1419 opened WIP, running local load tests. Observed resume_fail_rate reduced on spike run but still seeing partials.

 keisha: STATUS 2026-02-04: telemetry-only patch pushed to canary; `stream.partial` events are arriving and look correctly attributed. Opening REM-2026-203 now.

 telemetry-bot: Reminder: weekly watchlist sync Friday 09:00 PT.
